verified_context: A published scoping review described language-specific evidence gaps in evaluations of clinical language models across 62 non-English languages and did not establish safe clinical deployment. Illustrative photography may address communication and evaluation questions but cannot depict a validated translation service or a participant in the reported literature.
visual_idea: Two people in a staged healthcare-education discussion compare pictorial leaflets and a world map in warm natural light, emphasizing uncertainty and diverse language contexts rather than a deployed AI translator.
